P4_forcing.closed_form_proof: omega_lambda(e) = lambda * t + (1 - lambda) * s with t = Tr(A_e)/2 in [0,1] and s = s_e in [0,1]. Requiring both for the same e forces lambda_I and lambda_N into {0,1} with opposite choices; t = 1 with 0 <= A <= I_2 forces A = I_2 and then positivity of the complement forces s = 0, giving e = z_M; symmetrically the other branch gives e = z_s
